item.title: Dumped nitrous oxide cannisters and a TV!, 23rd August
item.description:
A delightful neighbour who was clearly having a party with underaged girls and much older men, has kindly dumped a box of nitrous oxide cannisters. Lucky for us they have left them in a box so that other people are free to also dump their rubbish there too. A lovely person has also hidden treasure behind the utilities box, yes find the TV and receive a special prize. Maybe a bag of dog poo as someone in the village also loves to deposit these behind utility boxes too.
